start.title: Connect the marketplace
start.lead: Three steps. First add the marketplace as a source, then install the plugins you need.
start.step1.title: Add the marketplace as a source
start.step1.text: Registers the catalog repository in your Claude Code.
start.step2.title: Install the plugin you need
start.step2.text: Install a specific plugin by name from this marketplace.
start.step2.note: After installing, run /reload-plugins or restart the session.
start.step3.title: Keep up to date
start.step3.text: Refresh the list of sources, then update the plugins you use.
start.step3.note: Auto-update is off by default for third-party marketplaces. Turn it on in /plugin → Marketplaces → {marketplace} → Enable auto-update.
start.info.update: marketplace update vs plugin update. The first refreshes the list of sources (where plugins come from); the second updates the code of a specific installed plugin.
start.info.team: For the whole team. Commit a shared .claude/settings.json so every teammate gets the marketplace and the plugins automatically. See the README section ↗.
